SELECT
  i.warehouse_id,
  SUM(i.quantity) AS current_stock,
  COALESCE(SUM(im.quantity), 0) AS outbound_90d,
  ROUND(90.0 * SUM(i.quantity) / NULLIF(SUM(im.quantity), 0), 1) AS turnover_days
FROM inventory i
LEFT JOIN inventory_movements im
  ON im.warehouse_id = i.warehouse_id
  AND im.movement_type = '2'
  AND im.moved_at >= (SELECT MAX(moved_at) FROM inventory_movements) - INTERVAL '90 days'
  AND im.moved_at < (SELECT MAX(moved_at) FROM inventory_movements)
GROUP BY i.warehouse_id
ORDER BY i.warehouse_id
LIMIT 100;
